subject: Banking
title: What Is a Credit Score?
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: What Is a Credit Score?.

hook.text: A three-digit number decides if you get a home, a car, or a credit card. Your credit score controls your financial life.

buildup.text: Credit scores range from 300 to 850. Above 740 is excellent. Below 580 means most lenders will say no.

discovery.text: The score predicts the probability you'll miss a payment in the next 24 months. Higher score means lower risk.

twist.text: 30% of credit reports contain errors. A mistake you don't know about could be silently lowering your score right now.

climax.text: A single number summarizes your entire financial history.

punchline.text: 300 to 850. One number controls your access to credit.

quiz.question: What does a credit score predict?
options: The probability you'll miss a payment in the next 24 months
